teaser: What happens when the urge to leave meets the instinct to stay and tend? You carry life path 5, the Adventurer, inside an ISFJ, built for care and continuity. The 5 wants variety, motion, the next hour not yet decided. The ISFJ wants the household fed, the schedule kept, the people nearby steady. In you these do not cancel out; they trade shifts. A week can open with a trip booked on a whim and close with every plate washed before anyone asks. The pairing is the pull between the door left open and the hand that keeps closing it gently.
